Senses.Explanation: The opening half of the Layman Fu's inherited verse: a thing ahead of heaven and earth, shapeless, lord of the ten-thousand forms, un-withered by the seasons. Wuyi Yuanlai voices the verse at the hall seat and sends each half to be sought in its opposite, the thing ahead of the world in the shapeless place and the shapeless in the thing, till the four lines close a lifetime of seeking, Juelang Daosheng quotes it at the birthday seat and asks who lacks the un-withering one, charging the crowd to break the net and settle the land, Xueguan Zhiyin quotes it and faults the lately-made teachers who claim the whole world is born from them, asking where that leaves the parents who bore them, and Faxi Yin raises it at the patron's celebration, faults it as far too bare-boned, then cuts the ground once with his staff for the birthday line. Pin Jixiang tests the three elders' offers against the verse and refuses each as another's world, not his face, till he owns no face and only borrows the ancients' nostrils to breathe, Zhufeng Zhenxu stands the staff in silence before the signs divide, recites the verse, and asks whose reach and eye this is, Fangrong Xi reads it so that before the three powers and the two poles there is already the root star of life, the wise knowing it as the buddha-nature and the lost calling it a ghost-soul, and Yunwai Ze rules the Layman Fu's words beautiful but not yet perfect, offering his own verse of the firecracker sending the twelfth month off and the plum bringing spring back.
